review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items measure vocabulary knowledge (meaning recognition and contextual usage). The supplied topic, label and module are appropriate; no substantive metadata changes needed. Verdict: PASS for both.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 items for P5 Chinese reading (part 2 of 5). Both items' metadata appropriately match the skill actually tested; no revisions required.

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 items (P5 Chinese reading, part 3 of 5). Both items ask students to infer a character trait or the reason for a character's action from a short description, and the supplied metadata (label, topic, module) accurately reflect that skill.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 items (P5 Chinese reading). Both items accurately labelled and categorised — no revision needed.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items for P5 Chinese reading. Both items measure straightforward reading-comprehension skills (main idea identification; text/paragraph organization). Metadata for both items is educationally coherent and accurately labels the measured skills. Recommend no changes.

reviews.reason: 題幹問「『堅持』最接近哪一個意思？」並以選項提供不同釋義，明確測驗詞語的意義辨識能力。標籤「字詞理解」、主題「字詞理解與運用」及模組「基礎掌握」都恰當描述此技能。
題幹要求從句子中選出最適合使用『堅持』的一句，測驗學生在語境中運用詞語的能力。標籤「詞語運用」比單純的詞義辨識更精確，但現有主題「字詞理解與運用」與模組「基礎掌握」也都適切。

The question asks for the main message conveyed by the sentence (identify what the person did). '訊息定位' (locating the information/message) and the label/module '訊息定位' / '理解與應用' fit the skill being assessed.
The item requires locating a specific detail (the latest arrival time) from a short notice. '訊息定位' as topic and '細節理解' as label under '理解與應用' accurately describe the skill.

The item asks students to infer a character trait from an action (modifying a plan and trying again), which is precisely '人物推論' and fits within the broader topic '人物與原因推論' and the module '情境推理' (drawing inferences from situational behaviour).

The item asks students to infer the likely reason for a character's behaviour (seeking information before deciding). This is correctly labelled '原因推論' and fits the topic '人物與原因推論' and module '情境推理' (inferring causes from actions).

The item asks students to recognise a rhetorical device (inanimate object given human action), i.e. personification. The label '修辭手法', topic '語境、修辭與句意' and module '理解與應用' correctly describe this skill.
The item requires identifying the main message of a single sentence (sentence-level meaning). The label '句意理解', topic '語境、修辭與句意' and module '理解與應用' accurately reflect this skill.

The item asks students to infer the article's central message from described content — this is clearly a main-idea (主旨辨認) task. The topic '整合閱讀' (integrative reading) and module '理解與應用' appropriately describe the comprehension skill required.

The item asks students to recognise the organisation/sequence of actions in a passage — a text-structure/paragraph-relationship skill. The label '段落關係', topic '整合閱讀', and module '理解與應用' accurately reflect the measured skill.
